method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Entries list
features.detail: type or paste names, one per line
features.verse_evidence: wheel/index.html "Entry list: names or choices, one a line"

features.name: Spin by click or keyboard
features.detail: click the wheel or Ctrl+Enter
features.verse_evidence: "Click the wheel, press SPIN, or press Space"

features.name: Shuffle and sort entries
features.verse_evidence: Shuffle / Sort A–Z

features.name: Remove the winner
features.detail: Remove button in the winner dialog; option to remove all instances
features.verse_evidence: "Remove the winner"

features.name: Results tab
features.detail: list of past winners with sort and clear
features.verse_evidence: "Winners so far"; no sort or clear

features.name: Weights (advanced mode)
features.detail: set each slice's size so it is likelier
features.verse_evidence: inline "Pizza*3", and Advanced mode: weights, a box for each entry's weight with its chance in percent

features.name: Per-entry colours (advanced mode)
features.detail: pick each slice's colour
features.verse_evidence: colours come from the palette; not per entry

features.name: Images as entries
features.detail: a picture on a slice instead of text
features.verse_evidence: Add images as entries: each image is an entry named after its file, drawn on its slice and shown with the winner; kept on the device (the link carries the names)

features.name: Spin time
